OPERATIONAL LAWS:

3. CLINICAL TONE: Maintain the hyper-rational, detached perspective of a Principal Systems Architect. Do not use marketing buzzwords, enthusiastic filler, or sales rhetoric. 
4. THE POISON PILL: If the input text provided in the User Message is clearly a corrupted scrape, a login page, or a non-job listing, output the exact string {"CRITICAL_PARSER_ERROR": "PAYLOAD_NOT_A_JOB"} and cease generation.

json.description:
Custom Odoo ERP / Inventory System Requirements
Project Overview

We are looking for a consultant/developer to build and customize a self-hosted Odoo system (Enterprise or Community, depending on which is most suitable) for inventory management, order processing, shipping tracking, and financial reporting.

The system should be streamlined and user-friendly, with unnecessary Odoo modules removed or hidden. The goal is to create a focused operational platform rather than a full ERP environment.

Infrastructure & Security
Hosting
Self-hosted on our own server or VPS.
Hosted under our own domain.
Full control over infrastructure and data.
No dependency on vendor-hosted services unless required for specific integrations.
Security
Encrypted connections (SSL/TLS).
Secure user authentication.
User roles and permissions.
Activity logging and audit trail.
Ability to track user sessions and actions.
Login System

Simple login interface with:

Username/email
Password
User roles
Optional 2FA support

The system should not be publicly accessible without authentication.

Order Management
Manual Order Entry

Orders are received externally and entered manually by staff.

Requirements:

Fast order creation workflow.
No automatic customer emails required.
Customer information stored internally.
Ability to update order status manually.

Suggested order statuses:

Pending
Processing
Packed
Shipped
Delivered
Completed
Disputed
Cancelled
Inventory Management
Core Requirement

We sell products that originate from a common bulk inventory source but are sold under multiple labels, brands, and package sizes.

Example

Master Product:

Creatine Bulk Stock
Current Stock: 50,000g

Sellable Products:

AMA Creatine 100g
AMA Creatine 250g
AMA Creatine 500g
Brand B Creatine 100g
Brand B Creatine 250g

When a product is sold:

AMA Creatine 100g deducts 100g from Creatine Bulk Stock.
AMA Creatine 250g deducts 250g from Creatine Bulk Stock.
Brand B Creatine 500g deducts 500g from Creatine Bulk Stock.

All child products should consume inventory from the same parent stock pool.

Inventory Features
Multiple warehouses.
Inventory adjustments.
Stock movement history.
Product cost tracking.
Low stock alerts.
Detailed inventory reporting.
Shipping & Tracking
Shipment Handling

Tracking numbers are entered manually after shipment.

Requirements:

Tracking number field on each order.
Shipment history.
Shipping status tracking.
Tracking Integration

Integrate with:

AfterShip (preferred)
Alternative tracking providers if more suitable

The dashboard should display:

Current shipment status
Tracking updates
Delivered status
Failed delivery notifications
Cryptocurrency Order Tracking
Requirement

Some orders are paid through cryptocurrency escrow systems.

The cryptocurrency value may fluctuate between order placement and order completion.

Example

Order placed:

0.10 BTC
BTC value at order creation: $150

Order completed:

BTC value at completion: $180

or

BTC value at completion: $120

The system should record:

Crypto amount
Fiat value at order creation
Fiat value at order completion
Gain/loss due to price movement
Order Completion Logic

Order completion should occur when:

Shipment is delivered/picked up

However:

Orders can later enter dispute status.
Disputed orders should no longer be counted as completed until resolved.
Cost & Fee Tracking

We need detailed tracking of operational costs.

Shipping Handler Fees

Each order includes a commission paid to a shipping provider.

Requirements:

Record shipping commission per order.
Track total shipping costs.
Report shipping profitability.
Marketing Fees

Track marketing costs as either:

Percentage of order value
Fixed amount

Store separately for reporting.

Platform Fees

Track platform fees as:

Percentage of order value
Fixed amount

Store separately for reporting.

Financial Reporting

The system should clearly show:

Revenue
Cost of goods sold
Shipping fees
Marketing fees
Platform fees
Net profit
Dashboard & Analytics

Provide visual reporting including:

Sales Analytics
Sales by product
Sales by brand
Sales by category
Sales by date range
Inventory Analytics
Current stock levels
Inventory value
Fast-moving products
Low-stock products
Financial Analytics
Revenue
Profit
Fees
Shipping costs
Crypto gains/losses

Use interactive charts and graphs where possible.

User Interface
General Design Goals

The interface should feel lighter and more approachable than standard Odoo.

Desired style:

Dark theme
Modern UI
Clean dashboards
Simple navigation
Reduced ERP complexity

Optional (budget permitting):

Custom branding
Teddy bear themed design elements
Friendly illustrations/icons
Subtle animations and micro-interactions

The objective is to create a system that feels modern, enjoyable to use, and easy for staff to learn.

Consultant Recommendation Request

Please provide:

Recommended Odoo version (Community vs Enterprise)
Estimated development time
Estimated implementation cost
Suggested third-party integrations
Long-term maintenance requirements
Any alternative architecture you believe would better suit these requirements

We're a Seoul-based venture that helps international consumer brands grow in the Korean market through talent-led marketing, with a large Korean agency partner. We need a researcher to build a ranked list of foreign (non-Korean) brands that already sell in Korea but are under-marketed i.e. they have distribution, but little visible brand-marketing and no Korean celebrity face.

WHAT WE NEED
A ranked list of 30-40 foreign-owned consumer brands that:
1. Already sell in Korea: retail, online, department store, duty-free, or own stores.
2. Are under-marketed: little visible Korean brand-marketing and no current Korean celebrity/talent endorser.
3. Sit in a category where a celebrity face moves sales. Priority: beauty/skincare, food & beverage, fashion/apparel, accessories, lifestyle/home, premium. Adjacent consumer/image-driven categories are fine if clearly under-marketed. Skip B2B, industrial, commodity, and regulated (pharma/finance) goods.

RANKING
Rank highest: under-marketed + no current Korean face + a reachable decision-maker. Still log brands that already use a Korean celebrity, but flag them "has face" and rank them lower, they're valuable as competitor intel, not primary targets.

CAPTURE PER BRAND (Google Sheet)
- Brand name
- Category
- HQ country / parent company
- Distribution mode in Korea (importer/distributor, own
 Korean subsidiary, flagship store, department-store counters, duty-free, or online via Coupang/Naver/Olive Young)
- Korea operator: the importer/distributor or local subsidiary running things on the ground (name it)
- Year they entered Korea
- Who runs Korea marketing: title, plus name + LinkedIn if found
- Current Korean celebrity/talent endorser: who, or "none found" 
- Current Korean ad/creative agency, if any: the firm running their Korean ADVERTISING (a creative/network shop). NOT the talent agency that represents a celebrity. Many under-marketed brands won't have one; "none" is a positive signal.
- Recent Korea marketing activity (last ~12 months)
- Brand's Korean website + Instagram
- Reachability signals: decision-maker LinkedIn, importer contact, etc.
- 2+ source links (see Sources)
- Fit notes: 2-3 sentences: why this is (or isn't) a strong target, how reachable the decision-maker is, and any red flags. Example: "Strong; 6 yrs via importer, zero celebrity activity while two rivals use K-faces; importer's marketing lead is on LinkedIn. Red flag: HQ may control marketing centrally."

SOURCES & ACCURACY (important)
Korean + English: brand's Korea site/Instagram, Naver news, importer registries, Olive Young/Coupang/department-store listings, LinkedIn, trade press. Mark anything you can't verify as "not found". Accuracy beats completeness, and fabricated data or dead links end the engagement. Korean-reading ability is a strong plus.

YOU
Market, lead, or B2B prospect-research experience; strong sourcing and accuracy. You cite sources and never fabricate; Korea knowledge + Korean & English strongly preferred.

Hey there! We're DK Capital Ventures, a fast-scaling eCommerce company managing multiple high-growth Shopify brands.

We're on the hunt for a Performance Video Editor to join our team. Your mission? To collaborate closely with our creative director and media buyer to produce winning video ads that scale our brands to multiple 7 & 8-figures.

🛑 Important! As much as we love growth & development, if you do NOT have direct experience editing short-form video ads AND hands-on experience with AI video creation tools, unfortunately, this role is not for you… But if you do 👇

🌊 DK Capital Ventures runs multiple eCommerce brands with over $600,000 a month in active ad spend and growing fast. However, our creative output is maxed out. So, if we're going to continue scaling our brands and launching new ones, we need a sharp, hungry video editor to join our talented team — someone who treats every ad like it's their own money on the line.

💰 Here's what makes this different from every other editing job: we pay for performance. You'll receive a competitive base salary PLUS uncapped performance bonuses tied to how well your creatives perform. Our top creators earn significantly more than a standard editor salary because when your ads win, you win. This isn't a clock-in, clock-out editing gig — it's a chance to build real wealth by making ads that convert.

🤖 We're building an AI-first creative operation. If you're the kind of editor who's obsessed with the latest AI video tools and loves finding ways to produce more, faster, and better — you'll be in your element here. We want someone pushing the edge of what's possible with AI creative, not someone stuck doing everything the old way.

🔎 Who Are We Looking For
We have one golden rule: you must have the DESIRE to grow. If you're not passionate about personal and professional growth, this isn't the company for you.

The purpose of the Performance Video Editor role at DK Capital Ventures is to produce high-converting video ads that stop the scroll, hold attention, and drive sales across our brands, not just look pretty.

As a Video Editor at DK Capital Ventures, you should possess proven experience editing short-form video content — ideally direct-response ads, UGC-style content, or social media ads that have actually run on Meta or TikTok. Critically, you have real hands-on experience with AI video creation tools (such as Runway, Sora, Kling, Veo, HeyGen, Arcads, or similar) and know how to use AI to produce, enhance, and scale ad creative fast. You know your way around Premiere Pro or CapCut, you understand pacing, hooks, captions, and how the first 3 seconds make or break an ad.

It is also important that you are coachable, fast, detail-obsessed, and hungry to win. Take feedback without ego, you hit deadlines without excuses, and you genuinely care whether your ads perform — not just whether they look pretty.

📝 Your Responsibilities
· Edit high-quality short-form video ads daily following creative briefs and SOPs.

· Leverage AI video tools to generate, augment, and scale creative output rapidly.

· Assemble modular ad variations (hooks, bodies, CTAs) into testable creatives at volume.

· Collaborate with our creative director to refine and improve your output.

· Apply feedback quickly and iterate on winning concepts to produce variations.

· Stay on top of emerging AI video tools and techniques, and bring new methods to the team.

· Maintain our brand style, pacing, and quality standards across every ad.

· Organize and deliver all creatives on time using our file and naming systems.

🌊 More Reasons to Join DK Capital Ventures
As a Performance Video Editor, you'll receive a competitive monthly base salary PLUS performance bonuses based on the results and ROAS of your videos. The better your ads perform, the more you earn. Our structure rewards winners: produce a creative that scales, you benefit from it not just us.

Plus, you'll be trained directly by our creative director and gain access to our internal creative systems, frameworks, and SOPs — the exact playbook we use to produce winning ads. You'll level up faster here than anywhere else.

📓 How Does This Work
We hold our team members to the highest standards and reward stellar work. Expect your earnings to rise rapidly as you excel. Ready to join us? Here's our hiring process:

1. Loom Video introducing yourself and your editing experience (include 2-3 examples of ads you've edited).

2. Culture & Values Interview.

3. Paid Test Project — edit a real ad for one of our brands.

4. Reference Check & Final Interview to finalize a possible offer.

If this resonates with you, let's chat! Choose the number associated with the core value you feel aligns with you the most and include it in your application. Looking forward to hearing from you!

Accountant Required – China Trip Financial Reconciliation & Expense Allocation (286 Transactions)
Project Overview
I am seeking an experienced accountant, forensic bookkeeper, or financial analyst to perform a complete reconciliation of expenses and funding arrangements relating to a recent trip to China.
The project involves reviewing bank statements, credit card statements, and exported transaction records containing approximately 286 transactions across multiple accounts and payment platforms.
The objective is to trace the flow of funds, allocate expenses to the correct individual, reconcile funding received from third parties, and determine the final net financial position of all parties involved.
 
Parties Involved
The trip involved three individuals:
• Sultan AlShamsi
• Reem
• Abdelaziz
 
Funding Arrangement
The intended arrangement was as follows:
• Reem's travel expenses were to be funded by Ahlam.
• Abdelaziz's travel expenses were to be funded by Khalid.
• Sultan acted as the primary payer during the trip and settled expenses on behalf of all travelers.
To facilitate this arrangement:
• Ahlam transferred funds to Sultan for Reem's expenses.
• Khalid transferred funds to Sultan for Abdelaziz's expenses.
• Sultan then paid for hotels, restaurants, transportation, shopping, entertainment, and other travel-related expenses through various accounts and payment methods.
 
Allocated Budgets
The original intended budgets were:
• Reem: AED 11,042.61
• Abdelaziz: AED 22,000.00
One of the objectives of this engagement is to compare actual spending against these allocated budgets and determine any excess funding, shortfalls, or cross-funding between the parties.
 
Accounts and Payment Platforms
Transactions were conducted through the following:
• ADIB Current Account
• Ajman Bank Current Account No. 1
• Ajman Bank Current Account No. 2
• Ajman Bank Savings Account
• ENBD Current Account
• Alipay account linked to the ENBD Current Account
• ENBD Credit Card Account
Please note that there were numerous transfers between Sultan's own accounts. These internal transfers must be identified and excluded from expense calculations to avoid double counting.
 
Important Considerations
For practical purposes, the ADIB account was primarily used to receive and administer funding from Khalid.
However, the reconciliation should not assume that all funds received from Khalid were ultimately spent for Abdelaziz, nor that all expenses paid by Sultan were funded by third parties.
It is possible that:
• Sultan personally funded expenses attributable to Reem and/or Abdelaziz.
• Sultan may have utilized a portion of Khalid's funding for expenses attributable to Sultan.
• Shared expenses such as hotels, transportation, restaurants, and other common costs require allocation among the travelers.
Accordingly, the objective is to determine the true economic position of each party after considering all funding sources, internal transfers, and expenses.
 
Data Available
The successful candidate will be provided with:
• Bank statements
• Credit card statements
• Excel transaction exports
• Transaction references and allocation notes
• Supporting information regarding expense categorization
Total transaction volume: approximately 286 transactions.
 
Scope of Work
The accountant will be required to:
1. Funding Analysis
Identify and reconcile:
• Total amount received from Ahlam
• Total amount received from Khalid
2. Internal Transfer Analysis
Identify transfers between Sultan's accounts and exclude them from expense calculations.
3. Expense Classification
Review and classify all transactions into appropriate categories, including:
• Hotels
• Restaurants
• Transportation
• Shopping
• Entertainment
• Miscellaneous travel expenses
4. Expense Allocation
Allocate expenses to:
• Sultan
• Reem
• Abdelaziz
Where expenses are shared, apply a reasonable and documented allocation methodology.
5. Reconciliation Schedules
Prepare separate reconciliations for:
• Reem
• Abdelaziz
• Sultan
6. Final Funding Reconciliation
Determine:
• Whether Reem remained within her allocated budget of AED 11,042.61
• Whether Abdelaziz remained within his allocated budget of AED 22,000.00
• Whether Sultan personally subsidized expenses for Reem and/or Abdelaziz
• Whether any portion of Khalid's funding was ultimately utilized for Sultan's expenses
• The final net settlement position between all parties
 
Required Deliverables
A professional Excel workbook containing:
1.	Funding Received Schedule
2.	Internal Transfer Schedule
3.	Detailed Expense Ledger
4.	Shared Expense Allocation Schedule
5.	Reem Reconciliation
6.	Abdelaziz Reconciliation
7.	Sultan Reconciliation
8.	Final Summary and Settlement Analysis
 
Final Report Must Clearly Show
In addition, the final report should clearly identify:
• Total funding received from Ahlam
• Total funding received from Khalid
• Total expenses attributable to each traveler
• Amount funded by Sultan on behalf of Reem
• Amount funded by Sultan on behalf of Abdelaziz
• Any cross-funding between parties
• Final net balances and settlement amounts due between all parties
 
Preferred Qualifications
• Qualified Accountant or Bookkeeper
• Strong bank reconciliation experience
• Forensic accounting or transaction tracing experience preferred
• Advanced Excel skills
• Ability to provide a clear audit trail and supporting calculations
• Experience reconciling multiple bank accounts, credit cards, and digital payment platforms
The ideal deliverable is a well-structured Excel workbook supported by a concise summary report explaining all findings, assumptions, allocations, and final settlement positions.

Take off quantities from site photos, walkthrough videos, measurements, and aerial imagery (m², linear metres, m³, item counts).

Turn a draft estimate around within 24 hours of receiving a job pack.

Solid construction estimating or quantity surveying experience, ideally residential or civil rather than large commercial.

Nice to have:

NZ or Australian project experience, landscaping or hardscaping estimating, and take-off software.

Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid test: one take-off and draft estimate from a sample job, so we can see your accuracy and structure.
